name: Alice
brief: A young girl who falls down a rabbit-hole and finds herself in a curious world.

name: White Rabbit
brief: A White Rabbit with pink eyes who carries a watch and wears a waistcoat.

name: Mouse
brief: A mouse who swam in the pool of tears and hated cats and dogs.

name: Dodo
brief: A bird who solemnly organized a Caucus-race and distributed prizes to all the party.

name: Lory
brief: An older bird of the party who insisted that age must know better.

name: Duck
brief: A bird in the pool of tears who questioned the archbishop's findings.

name: Eaglet
brief: A young bird who did not know the meaning of long words.

name: Caterpillar
brief: A large blue caterpillar sitting on a mushroom with its arms folded, quietly smoking a hookah.

name: Puppy
brief: An enormous puppy in the woods who tried to play with Alice.

name: Bill
brief: The poor little Lizard who was sent down the chimney by the Rabbit.
